meta.scope: Uruguay batch 3 — Montevideo metro, departmental poverty contrast, MERCOSUR & trade agreements, education/health presence, and fiscal anchors. Completes the homogeneity check.
meta.homogeneity_note: Same national ECH framework. Border departments (Artigas, Rivera, Cerro Largo) carry the highest poverty; southern departments (Colonia, Maldonado, Flores, San José) are among the lowest. Montevideo has higher poverty than the Interior average in some measures, with strong intra-city variation.

candidates.title: Montevideo — capital statistical identity
candidates.description: Capital city and primary urban economy. Core domain for ECH labour, income and poverty analysis. Higher average incomes than the Interior but also elevated poverty incidence in peripheral areas.
candidates.notes: Dominant metro node. Continuously published as a distinct geographic domain (Montevideo vs Interior) in ECH income and poverty reports. Intra-city periphery carries higher poverty than the southern coastal strip.

candidates.title: Departamento de Artigas — high-poverty border contrast
candidates.description: Northern border department with among the highest poverty incidence in the 2025 departmental results.
candidates.notes: Poverty-contrast department. Frequently ranked with Rivera and Cerro Largo among the highest-poverty departments.

candidates.title: Departamento de Rivera — high-poverty border contrast
candidates.description: Northern border department with elevated poverty incidence. Completes the northern border contrast set.
candidates.notes: 2025 poverty ranking places Rivera among the highest-poverty departments alongside Artigas and Cerro Largo.

candidates.title: Departamento de Cerro Largo — high-poverty border contrast
candidates.description: Northeastern border department with elevated poverty incidence.
candidates.notes: Completes the high-poverty northern/northeastern border cluster.

candidates.title: Departamento de Colonia — low-poverty contrast
candidates.description: Southern department with among the lowest poverty incidence in the 2025 results.
candidates.notes: Low-poverty southern department. Completes the contrast pole opposite the northern border departments.

candidates.title: Pobreza por departamento (INE)
candidates.description: Official departmental tabulations of income poverty. Primary source for the inter-departmental poverty gradient.
candidates.notes: Key homogeneity-test product. 2025 extremes: Artigas, Rivera, Cerro Largo highest; San José, Maldonado, Colonia, Flores lowest. National persons under LP ~16.6%.

candidates.title: MERCOSUR (ACE 18) — marco comercial
candidates.description: Southern Common Market customs-union and trade framework of which Uruguay is a founding member. Core preferential-trade arrangement with Argentina, Brazil and Paraguay.
referenced_by: Official trade reporting with MERCOSUR partners
candidates.notes: Foundational regional instrument. Continuously cited in Uruguayan trade and integration analysis. Uruguay has long advocated flexibility for smaller members within the bloc.

candidates.title: Acuerdo MERCOSUR–Unión Europea
candidates.description: Trade agreement between MERCOSUR and the European Union. Provisional application of the interim trade agreement began in 2026; major preferential-access instrument for Uruguayan agro-exports.
candidates.notes: Landmark external agreement. Continuously cited as a major opening for beef, dairy and other agro-products into the EU market.

candidates.title: Presupuesto Nacional / National Budget
candidates.description: Annual national budget law and subsequent execution reports covering revenues and expenditure of the central government.
candidates.notes: Operational fiscal framework. Links tax and other revenues with functional spending on education, health, social protection and investment.

candidates.title: Gasto público en educación y salud
candidates.publisher: Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas / INE
candidates.description: Public expenditure on education and health as reflected in the national budget and related functional statistics. Complements household-survey education and health modules.
candidates.notes: Education and health are major and constitutionally prioritised functional allocations. Continuously tracked in budget execution and social-policy analysis.

proposed_edges.basis: Departmental poverty tables are geographic disaggregations of the national income-poverty measurement.
Montevideo is a primary geographic domain of the ECH.
Artigas’s high poverty ranking is derived from the departmental poverty tabulations.
MERCOSUR preferential trade is a recurring analytical dimension of merchandise-trade reporting.
The EU agreement underpins preferential access for major agro-exports.
Education and health are major functional allocations in the national budget.
